sum: Advasa Holdings, Inc., a financial technology and services company, provides a suite of financial services and solutions in Japan. Its core product, the FUKUPE platform, is a patented Earned Wage Access (EWA) solution that provides employees with real-time access to earned wages through cashless receipts and settlements that integrate with wallets, cards, and bank accounts. Its patented system consists in gathering, using, and managing necessary employee and employer-related data to ensure access to on-demand payroll for employees, while integrating with the HR and payroll systems that employers already have in place. The company license its EWA technology portfolio and offer original equipment manufacturer services. Advasa Holdings, Inc. was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
